name: Detalle de Oreja
description: Compara la consistencia de detalles entre oreja izquierda y derecha
algorithm: Ear Detail Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes ear anatomical detail for deepfake detection:

1. **Ear Región Extracción**: Ears are detected and segmented using facial landmark extensions and ear-specific detectors. The ear region includes the helix, antihelix, tragus, antitragus, concha, and lobule — each with distinctive anatomical structure that serves as a biometric identifier.

2. **Anatomical Detail Evaluación**: Fine ear structures are analyzed: cartilaginous ridges (helix curvature, antihelix branching), skin texture, and vascular patterns. Real ears exhibit high-frequency anatomical detail with complex 3D surface geometry. AI-generated ears typically show simplified anatomy — missing the intricate folds or producing physically impossible ear structures.

3. **Bilateral Simetría Verificación**: Left and right ears of the same person share characteristic family resemblance while showing natural asymmetry. The method compares both ears for anatomical consistency — deepfakes may produce ears with inconsistent morphology between sides, or ears that don't match the identity of the generated face.

4. **Temporal Ear Estabilidad**: Ear anatomy is rigid (cartilage doesn't deform) and should remain geometrically stable across frames regardless of head motion. The method tracks ear detail consistency — deepfake generators may produce temporally inconsistent ear rendering with fluctuating detail levels, especially when the ear is near the face-swap boundary.

5. **Ear - Rostro Identity Coherencia**: Ear morphology is correlated with face shape and ethnicity. The method checks whether ear characteristics are plausible for the depicted face. Deepfakes that swap faces but not ears (or generate ears independently) may produce biometrically inconsistent ear-face combinations.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante ear detail consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
